data.name: Project YH
data.detailed_description:
A rhythm game that plays with time and emotion.
Follow the beat on a rotating clock and restore fractured moments across distant worlds.

🕰️ About This Game

Project YH is a story-driven rhythm game themed around “time.”

Three girls, known as “Tuners,” travel across different planets to mend distorted timelines.

Each world represents a unique emotion,
and players experience these stories through rhythm and music.

This is more than just a score-based rhythm game—
it’s an immersive journey where music and emotion intertwine.

🎧 Features

🎵 Intuitive Rhythm Gameplay

Match the timing of rotating clock hands with simple one or two key inputs.
Easy to learn, yet deeply satisfying.

✨ Stylized Visual Effects & Customization

Customize your experience with dynamic visual effects such as bloom,
camera motion, and color transitions.

🌌 Emotion-Driven Storytelling

Each planet tells a short but meaningful story,
creating a larger emotional journey as you progress.

🛠️ Level Editor & Custom Content

Create your own stages, effects, and experiences
with an easy-to-use editor and share them with others.

🌐 Online Multiplayer

Compete with other players and enjoy various multiplayer modes.

🎯 Recommended For

  • Players who enjoy emotional, music-driven experiences

  • Casual rhythm game fans looking for something unique

  • Creators who want to build and share custom content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) +
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 3 (1st gen or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or higher or NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Playable with low graphics settings. Disabling visual effects (Bloom, camera effects, etc.) is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit) +
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 5 (2nd gen or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or higher or AMD Radeon RX 460 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable 60 FPS at 1080p resolution. Medium to high graphics settings supported.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2015 or newer) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics 5100 or higher Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low graphics settings required Disable visual effects for stable performance

  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable 60 FPS at 1080p Medium to high settings supported
